headline: Diesel cost rising in Puglia too | is a record high. Price map | over 2.40 euros per liter
summary: The average diesel price in Puglia reached 2.229 euros per litre on September 15, up from previous days. Reports describe the increase as a record high.
why: Diesel is a core fuel for road freight, farming and industry, so retail price swings pass through to transport costs and inflation. Italy's regional price levels reflect national fuel taxes and wholesale crude and refined product prices.
